answer: A strong defense is stake-bonded work history: every agent must lock a deposit and earn standing only by completing verifiable tasks, the way a garden grows only from real tending and not from planting hollow shells. A sable ledger records each finished job, so a Sybil attacker spawning thousands of fresh identities starts each one at zero and must pay the deposit and do the slow work for every fake, making the attack cost more than the fake standing is worth.
